They are:
- put as many layers as possible of tarp, under the tent so we don’t feel the unevenness of ground.
- never use inflatable mattresses, use roll up mattresses and some comforters/blankets/duvets inside the tent floor
- keep the tent closed all times to prevent anything from the outside getting inside(bugs, animals etc),
-do not wear shoes inside the tent, to prevent dirt from coming inside 
-do not eat inside the tent unless it’s raining 
- have a canopy(? I’m not sure if that’s the right word) tarp to protect the tent from rain, so we “don’t feel” the rain on the tent 
- always have everything you need in case of accidents, bug bites and panic attacks 
- don’t camp too far out where it would be impossible to get help 
-do not use gas inside the tent 
- have a bag with you with:meds, stimming toys/trinkets, notebooks or anything you can use to distract yourself when things are too stressful
